gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-hahmlet: Expressive Balsamiq Sans traces every curve like a single marker tip. Hahmlet underneath is a serif with a faint charcoal-pressure shadow in its curves, so the marker-smooth heading meets something more dignified.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-im-fell-english-: Blunt and hairline-free, Balsamiq Sans leads while IM Fell English SC thins its strokes without turning spindly. The heading font earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-inria-serif: Inria Serif reads refined, its wide-mouthed rounds paired with slightly lighter diagonals. Over pages of text the faint nib pressure keeps things gently alive, while Balsamiq Sans stays steady from stem to curve.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-joan: Balsamiq Sans has a neon-tube thickness that never pinches or tightens at the curves. And Joan, the serif below, keeps its thicks mild and the inside of its c clearly visible.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-junge: Junge reads authoritative, with generous gaps in its curves and strokes that taper only slightly, like a candle flame. Balsamiq Sans does uninterrupted monoline lines best, Junge the subtle shift in width.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-kameron: Single-thickness strokes: that's Balsamiq Sans, bold and expressive, like a fixed pen. Kameron lightens its curves mildly and skips sharp hairlines, which is exactly what makes this pairing click.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-libertinus-serif: Unshaded, plain lines: Balsamiq Sans is bold and expressive. But Libertinus Serif does the quiet work, with a mellow range of stroke weights and a slight swell on the bowls.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-libre-caslon-tex: Libre Caslon Text, a serif, gives modest thick-thin contrast and pen-lifted curves that leave loops unfinished. Libre Caslon Text lets Balsamiq Sans be the bold, expressive one, its fixed-pen strokes never varying.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-lustria: Lustria is traditional and authoritative, its weight changes present but never dramatic. Balsamiq Sans, drawn like lengths of rounded cord, makes the heading expressive, while the text serif below it modulates without snagging the eye.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-maitree: Dignified Maitree gives its curves open mouths and a measured swell from hairline to stem. And Balsamiq Sans, bold and expressive, traces every glyph with a single thickness, which is where the pairing gets its spark.
